parameters.jsonBody:
={{
(() => {
  const m = $('Merge Student + Slot').item.json;
  const s = m.student || {};
  return {
    runId: String($execution.id),
    captureArtifacts: true,
    useSchedulerPost: true,
    submitMode: 'browser',
    dsgvoAccepted: true,
    maxCaptchaRetries: 10,
    sessionCookie: m.sessionCookie,
    Language: m.Language || 'en',
    Office: m.Office,
    CalendarId: String(m.CalendarId),
    PersonCount: String(m.PersonCount || '1'),
    currentMonday: m.currentMonday,
    currentSlot: m.currentSlot || m.slotValue,
    student: {
      Lastname: s.Lastname,
      Firstname: s.Firstname,
      DateOfBirth: s.DateOfBirth,
      TraveldocumentNumber: s.TraveldocumentNumber,
      Sex: String(s.Sex),
      Street: s.Street,
      Postcode: String(s.Postcode),
      City: s.City,
      Country: String(s.Country),
      Telephone: String(s.Telephone),
      Email: s.Email,
      LastnameAtBirth: s.LastnameAtBirth,
      NationalityAtBirth: String(s.NationalityAtBirth),
      CountryOfBirth: String(s.CountryOfBirth),
      PlaceOfBirth: s.PlaceOfBirth,
      NationalityForApplication: String(s.NationalityForApplication),
      TraveldocumentDateOfIssue: s.TraveldocumentDateOfIssue,
      TraveldocumentValidUntil: s.TraveldocumentValidUntil,
      TraveldocumentIssuingAuthority: String(s.TraveldocumentIssuingAuthority),
    },
  };
})()
}}
